protocol.primary: Report terminal tasks solved and paired per-apparatus solved-count differences; every completed case is included irrespective of quality. Describe each resource separately.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired percentile bootstrap over independent apparatus instances, stratified to retain 15 cases per generator profile; 10000 resamples with seed 20261005. Report 95% intervals for mean solved-count, mean MSE, and research-resource differences. These intervals address within-family instance variation.
protocol.costs: Record research and terminal-evaluation costs separately, with process CPU seconds for each. Equal ceilings do not imply equal actual spending. Full can pool unused resources for revisits; independent task-local researcher cannot borrow from other tasks.
protocol.interpretation: Task-local memory preserves all within-task learning. Fixed basis has restricted expressivity. Passive design also removes adaptive revisits. Source-deletion effects from the earlier cohort are distinct. No external Code/LLM claim.
protocol.development_repair: Fixed passive acquisition to choose a legal alternative instrument view; no proposal or confirmation algorithm was changed.
